Dear Fjord Components AS,

Thank you for your revised quotation of 0.78 USD per unit with an 18-day lead time for 10,000 M8 stainless hex bolts.

We appreciate your efforts to accommodate our requirements. To finalize this order, we would need a unit price of 0.72 USD and a lead time of 16 days.

If you are able to meet these terms, we are ready to proceed. Please let us know if this is possible.

We value working with you and look forward to your response.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
